headline: Duke Energy (DUK) Stock Could Be 29% Pricey After Data Center Savings News
summary: Duke Energy stock has delivered a 57.4% return over the past three years, yet its current US$125.43 share price sits at the center of a valuation split. The Dividend Discount Model (DDM) points to a premium to intrinsic value, while earnings-based multiples suggest the shares may still be on the cheap side. With these methods pulling in different directions, the stock does not screen as a straightforward bargain or an obvious overpricing. Over the last three years, Duke Energy has returned...
